name: locknote
description: Locknote — modern zero-knowledge secret sharing platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vercel.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
